invoice.name: Free Invoice & Quotation Generator for Jamaica
invoice.description: Create invoices and quotations in JMD or other currencies. Add line items, discounts and optional tax, then print or save as PDF. Free, no account needed.
invoice.heading: Create a Jamaican dollar invoice or quotation online
invoice.intro: Prepare a quotation for a customer, then create an invoice when the work is agreed. This free invoice maker supports JMD, USD, CAD, GBP and EUR for sole traders and small businesses in Jamaica and beyond.
steps: Choose Invoice or Quotation, currency, reference and date.
Add your business, customer and line items; review any discount, tax and payment instructions.
Check the preview, then print or save as PDF. Save locally or download a JSON backup if you want to reuse the document.

faq.q: Can I create an invoice in JMD and save it as PDF?
faq.a: Yes. Choose JMD, complete your document and use Print / Save PDF. Your browser provides the PDF destination. The finished document includes the LearnTech credit.

faq.q: Does it calculate my tax obligations?
faq.a: No. You choose any applicable tax rate and must check that the document meets your business and customer requirements. The tool calculates the entries you provide; it is not an accounting or tax-advice service.

faq.q: Do I need to email my customer details?
faq.a: No. Creating, printing and downloading work without email. Local saves stay in this browser profile, so keep a JSON backup and avoid saving sensitive documents on a shared device.

website.name: Free Website Health Checker Online
website.description: Check a public page for HTTPS, mobile setup, search information and image markup. Get practical website health observations and download a free report.
website.heading: Check website basics before planning your next update
website.intro: Use this free website checker to get a first look at one public page. It helps Jamaican business owners and website managers ask clearer questions about their site, without needing an account.
steps: Enter the public page address without a login, query string or private information.
Review the observations and suggested next steps for search information, mobile setup, image markup and selected headers.
Download the report and discuss the findings with your developer. Use the linked PageSpeed Insights service for a separate performance assessment.

faq.q: Is this a complete security or speed audit?
faq.a: No. It checks one public HTML page and selected response headers. It does not test for exploitable vulnerabilities, measure all visitor experiences or crawl the whole website.

faq.q: Can it verify my PHP version or website backups?
faq.a: A PHP version is visible only when the server exposes a relevant header, which may be absent or misleading. Website backups cannot be verified publicly; ask your developer for a recent backup and evidence of a successful restore test.

faq.q: How is it different from the SEO checker?
faq.a: The website health report covers broader public-page observations. The SEO checker focuses on page titles, descriptions, headings, canonical addresses, indexing directives and image alternative attributes.

seo.name: Free SEO Checker — Page Titles, Meta Tags & More
seo.description: Check on-page SEO basics: titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonical URLs, indexing directives and image alt attributes. Get a free page-level report.
seo.heading: Check on-page SEO essentials in one public page
seo.intro: This free SEO checker helps you spot missing page information before asking for a website update. It is useful for business websites in Jamaica and elsewhere, whether you manage the site yourself or work with a developer.
steps: Enter the public page you want to review, such as a service or product page.
Read each observation about titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonical URLs, indexing directives and image alt attributes.
Download the report, make relevant improvements and check the page again. Use Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools to inspect actual indexing.

faq.q: Will a good report guarantee Google rankings?
faq.a: No. These are presence checks, not a ranking score. They do not measure keyword demand, backlinks, competition, writing quality or actual indexing. A present title or alt attribute can still need improvement.

faq.q: Does this check every page on my website?
faq.a: No. Submit each important public page separately. Different service and product pages should describe their own content accurately rather than repeat the same title and description.

image.name: Free Image Compressor, Resizer & Converter Online
image.description: Compress, resize and convert JPEG, PNG and WebP images in your browser. Choose dimensions, crop or fit, preview and download. No upload or account needed.
image.heading: Resize, compress and convert images for websites and social posts
image.intro: Prepare a product photo, website banner or social post without uploading it. The free image converter accepts still JPEG, PNG and WebP files and exports those same formats, with a visible LearnTech credit strip.
steps: Choose a still JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 20 MB and 24 megapixels.
Select a preset or custom dimensions, choose fit or centre crop, and set JPEG or WebP quality if needed.
Create a preview, compare the file size and check the crop before downloading the finished image.

faq.q: Can I convert PNG to JPEG or JPEG to WebP?
faq.a: Yes. Select your source image and choose the download format. JPEG uses a white background. PNG and WebP can keep transparency when you select that option.

faq.q: Can this convert an image to SVG?
faq.a: Not currently. SVG stores vector shapes; turning a photo into editable paths needs a tracing process. Putting a JPEG or PNG inside an SVG wrapper does not make it a true vector image. This tool currently accepts and exports JPEG, PNG and WebP only.

faq.q: Will compression always make my file smaller?
faq.a: No. Format changes, output dimensions and the LearnTech credit can increase file size. Review the size shown in the preview. Enlarging a small image does not create extra detail.

brandsnap.name: Add Logo & Text to Photos Online — Free BrandSnap
brandsnap.description: Add your logo and text to photos with free BrandSnap. Choose logo placement, text banners and social-post sizes. Download JPEG, PNG or WebP. No upload.
brandsnap.heading: Add a logo and text to product photos and social posts
brandsnap.intro: BrandSnap is a free photo branding tool from LearnTech Foundation in Jamaica. Add your business logo, event name or promotional message to an image, then choose a square, portrait, story or custom canvas.
steps: Choose a photo and an optional logo. Transparent PNG logos work well.
Add your headline and message, choose banner colours and position your logo.
Choose dimensions and format, create a preview, then download. Check text contrast, crop and spelling before sharing.

faq.q: Can I add a logo without stretching it?
faq.a: Yes. BrandSnap preserves the logo proportions. You can choose its size, position and opacity, or add a white backing to help it stand out.

faq.q: Are my photos uploaded or saved online?
faq.a: No. Your selected photo, logo and text are processed in this browser. Reset clears the current session; downloaded files stay on your device. Optional camera access starts only when you press Start camera.

faq.q: Can I create Instagram or Facebook images?
faq.a: Yes. Use a square, portrait, story or custom canvas, then upload the downloaded image to your chosen platform. BrandSnap does not post to social accounts. Every download includes the LearnTech credit.
